candidates.warmup_and_state: Window and ramp are independent upstream settings; inspect partial-window behavior.
candidates.semantic_edges: Integer and date-offset windows are distinct.
candidates.integration_requirements: Freeze window, minimum observations, NaN handling and session/calendar interpretation before integration.

candidates.formula_summary: ema[t] = beta * ema[t-1] + (1-beta) * x[t], pandas ewm(adjust=False).
candidates.semantic_edges: Beta weights previous state; this differs from period-based alpha and an SMA seed.
candidates.integration_requirements: Freeze initialization, reset, gap and out-of-order policies; persist/replay state.

candidates.formula_summary: Moving average plus/minus k times rolling standard deviation.
candidates.semantic_edges: Upstream output has lower and upper columns; no middle column. Pin ddof and NaN behavior in conformance tests.
candidates.integration_requirements: Freeze window, minimum observations, NaN handling and session/calendar interpretation before integration. Bind ordered named outputs in the model schema.

candidates.formula_summary: Rolling covariance(asset returns, benchmark returns) / rolling variance(benchmark returns).
candidates.warmup_and_state: First three returned rows are forced missing; window/ramp also apply.
candidates.semantic_edges: prices=True converts levels to simple returns; prices=False expects returns. Zero benchmark variance is undefined.
candidates.integration_requirements: Freeze benchmark identity, same-time index alignment and return basis. Freeze window, minimum observations, NaN handling and session/calendar interpretation before integration.

candidates.formula_summary: RollingOLS after dropping nonfinite rows and aligning X/y; exposes coefficients, fit statistics and fitted values.
candidates.warmup_and_state: Window must exceed the number of regressors including intercept.
candidates.semantic_edges: A fitted value uses a regression containing its current response; it is not an out-of-sample prediction.
candidates.integration_requirements: Use only mature, available responses; separate fit cutoff from forecast time and retain training lineage.

candidates.formula_summary: Trend component of seasonal_decompose using its centered moving-average filter.
candidates.warmup_and_state: Requires full decomposition history and endpoint handling.
candidates.semantic_edges: Centered filtering can use future observations.
candidates.integration_requirements: Blocked for point-in-time features. A causal redesign must have a distinct definition and separate validation.
